eurostat.decision: No teacher denominator in this dataset. Greater-city label is not assumed to match Dublin City municipal scope; no boundary equivalence was recovered.

cso.decision: National primary/secondary teacher series has no Dublin city denominator or matched upper-secondary/provider breakdown. No inference about FTE units is needed for this geographic rejection.

task4_v165_dublin_routes.interpretation: Missing geography/stage/provider variables are not zero-valued teachers. No ratio, utility, city extrapolation or allocation-to-actual conversion is computed.
task4_v165_dublin_routes.excluded_prior_routes: No reused ETB376.1 allocation upper bound,411.8/3862 mismatched-year ratio, or private-provider exclusion substitution.
